# representation-smoke fixtures

Synthetic fixtures for the representation contract (revision v1.3,
`docs/decisions/0005-representation-contract.md`). Every credential-shaped
string is `SYNTHETIC_EXAMPLE_KEY_NEVER_ISSUED_01` or an encoding of it; none is
a real credential.

| File | Contract |
|---|---|
| `corpus-snapshot.json` | `CorpusSnapshot` declaring `identity.representation`, with eight cases: a whole-value base64 span with a `decoded` fact, a hex span inside JSON, a nested url-safe-over-standard base64 span, a fragmented span after multi-byte text (UTF-8 byte offsets), zero-width code points removed by `strip-codepoints`, an expected rejection (a UTF-16 chunk boundary inside an emoji), a pending base64 projection with lineage only, and an ordinary raw control. Generated by `crates/credential-eval-contracts/tests/representation.rs`; regenerate with `UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 cargo test -p credential-eval-contracts --test representation`. |
| `run-config.json` | The `contracts-smoke` run configuration (two canned scanners). |
| `observation-set.json` | Canned observations. `fake-scanner-a` places decoded findings on their source segments (`mapping`) and finds the fragmented secret as one range. `fake-scanner-b` leaves the hex case unmeasured (`unmeasured`), which is in no denominator and is never a miss. |
| `expected-run-artifact.json` | The golden `RunArtifact`: `manifest.representation`, `mapping` on findings and on case rows, the expected rejection and the pending projection `pending`, the unmeasured case `not-measured`. |

The test is `crates/credential-eval-kernel/tests/representation_smoke.rs`;
regenerate the golden artifact with
`UPDATE_GOLDEN=1 cargo test -p credential-eval-kernel --test representation_smoke`.
